With AI Deterrence, you can add verbal messages that include details of the intruder and a verbal
warning to leave with your choice of voice and tone.

notifications about what’s important to you.

notifications.

Use two-way audio capabilities to talk to whoever is at your door.

# Advanced Wiring Solutions

## CCTV Systems, Alarm Systems, Surveillance Cameras, and More

### Why Choose Us for Commercial and Home Security?

At Advanced Wiring Solutions we believe the customer and employees our number one priority. This
philosophy flows down to the workforce through conversations between the company’s owners and our
personnel. We believe in providing cost effective solutions for commercial and residential
properties to stay up to date with the latest security features and technology.

We are located in the Frederick, Maryland area and install and service [CCTV systems][26], security
cameras, [security and fire alarm systems][27], [access control systems][28], [home automation
systems][29], voice/data systems, and more throughout the Maryland, Virginia, Washington DC, and PA
regions.

Since 2010, Advanced Wiring Solutions has been a industry leader in commercial and home security
systems. We provide the right solution with professional installation and integration, and our
products are backed by our dependable service and support. We do not believe in any sort of term
based contract. We believe that people can see through the “free” systems that are offered. If you
are unhappy with our service and our promise doesn’t live up to your expectation you are free to
cancel at anytime.

Our goal is to exceed our customer’s expectations by providing exact solutions and listening to our
clients’ needs, while emphasizing a professional, neat appearance.  **We work with our clients to
find solutions to their problems in the most cost-effective manner possible.**

[Learn More About our Security Offerings Today!][30]

### CCTV Systems

**CCTV camera systems can help any business or home to deter theft before it happens,** to catch
someone in the act, or to find out what happened after the fact. Whether you need one camera system
or if you’re looking for large scale multi camera system, or have a existing system that you want to
upgrade with the latest technology we can help make it simple, cost efficient and effective.
[MORE][31]

### Alarm Systems

**Alarm system is a key component in any office, retail, or government space these days.** In order
to keep your business protected. A basic alarm package can provide ample peace of mind to a busy
business owner or manager who knows their business is at risk for break-ins. We offer cost effective
solutions to create the most secure environment possible. Our certified and experienced technicians
will take the time to explain all features. [MORE][32]

### Access Control Systems

**Access Control systems can help to protect your business in many ways.** When used in offices to
protect valuable records, paperwork and inventory, an electric lock and a card reader can be all
that’s needed to provide some peace of mind. Easy to use devices like key fobs, key cards, and most
recently, smart phones can be given privileged user access, timed access, and can even hold contact
information about the tenant or employee to whom it is assigned. [MORE][33]

# [Athenalarm – Professional Intrusion Alarm Manufacturer & Network Alarm Monitoring Solutions
# Provider][78]

***Delivering industrial-grade intrusion alarm panels, sensors, network alarm systems, and
integrated network alarm monitoring system trusted by security integrators, distributors, and
commercial project contractors worldwide**** — including advanced wireless GSM/4G WiFi alarm systems
ideal for both residential and small-business protection.***

[athenalarm]

Since 2006, Athenalarm has been dedicated to developing professional intrusion alarm systems for
security integrators, distributors, and commercial projects worldwide. We manufacture alarm control
panels, motion detectors, alarm sensors, alarm software, and integrated network alarm monitoring
systems that combine intrusion detection, communication technologies, and centralized management.

Our solutions are designed for banks, schools, factories, warehouses, retail stores, residential
communities, and other security-critical facilities. From standalone alarm installations to
centralized monitoring networks, Athenalarm helps customers build reliable and scalable security
systems tailored to diverse application requirements.

With OEM, ODM, and private-label manufacturing capabilities, supported by continuous innovation and
professional technical support, Athenalarm has become a trusted partner for distributors, system
integrators, and security professionals across global markets. We are committed to delivering
dependable alarm technologies that help create safer and more connected environments.

➜ [Learn More About Athenalarm][79]

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

Managed Security

## Intruder and Security Alarm Installation

**[Burglar Alarms - Home Alarms:][146]** If you are looking into the installation of a home alarm
system it might be useful to know that the crime rate in Great Britain has been soaring annually.
Over the course of the year 2018-2019 there were over a million burglaries and robbery attempts in
the UK, with four hundred and twenty two thousand robberies reported in England and Wales alone.
(Source: Statista, Crime and Law Enforcement figures).

[[Free UK Burglar Alarm Quotes]][147]

Regrettably, it remains common for individuals to consider implementing an intruder detection system
or burglar alarm only after experiencing a break-in. The statistics reveal that in the UK, 47% of
burglaries are categorised as opportunistic by law enforcement. Consequently, their recommendation
is to proactively discourage potential criminals by equipping your residence or enterprise with an
alarm system. Shield yourself from the emotional distress and anxiety inflicted by a burglary by
investing in a security system tailored to the specific needs of your property. However, given the
wide array of intruder alarms available, determining the ideal choice can be a challenging task.

[Burglar Alarms UK]

Security and alarm systems cater to a wide range of budgets. For those with ample resources, a
specialized security provider can professionally install, maintain, and diligently monitor your
alarm system. On the opposite end of the spectrum, there are straightforward battery-powered systems
that can be set up and activated within minutes. Additionally, you'll find options in both wireless
and wired configurations. Many of these systems can seamlessly integrate with CCTV for capturing
potential intruders on camera for later identification. Before making your security alarm
investment, it's prudent to carefully consider its intended purpose.

### TYPES OF BURGLAR ALARM

**Audible/Visual Only Burglar Alarms** - These alarms are restricted to an internal or external bell
and/or a visual indicator showing that the alarm's been set off. This alarm notifies occupants and
neighbours but does not report the occurrence via text or voice message to a cell phone.

Pros:
* Easy installment can be achieved by an individual with DIY capabilities.
* The actual alarm box is a visual deterrent which can help to discourage would be intruders.

Cons:
* Recognition of the alarm is confined to those in or near to the property or building.
* False alarms in past times have rendered people "alarm immune".

[Burglar Alarm Installation UK]

**Auto-Dial Security Alarms** - These have all the features of a visual audio alarm, but is also
able to send a SMS text via a prepaid SIM card or dial out via a landline to send a recorded voice
message. This permits the alarm control unit to deliver a text or voice message to predetermined
contacts with some systems allowing several contacts to be included in a cascade system of phoning.
If multiple contacts are used then if the first one does not acknowledge the warning then the second
one on the list is informed, and so forth until verification.

Pros:
* An alarm activation will immediately send a notification to warn a contact.
* Supplemental sensors can be added to warn you of flooding, carbon monoxide or fire.

[list of things to do to deter unlawful individuals][33].

night time warning potential burglars that your alarm is Live! Always set your Alarm when your out
and in bed at night.

**A fully activating Alarm** is very loud, which will make the potential burglar uneasy and
hopefully scare him away!

Have a least **2 Security Lights** on your property, One at the Front and One at the Rear. Lights
are a fantastic deterrent to unlawful individuals as they would prefer to carry out there criminal
activities in the dark!

Have good **quality CCTV System** not only for evidence but to deter unlawful individuals.

**Quality locks** on your Door and Windows is another great way to slow them down or even prevent a
break-in into your property.

**Never leave ladders, gardening equipment** or tools outside your property, e.g. on your driveway
or in your garden! These are perfect items that the burglar will use to help in committing his/her
crime!

**Summary:** Make your property un-attractive to a potential burglar/unlawful individual.. A well
protected property will make this individual think twice about committing a crime on your property.

# Electronic Circuit Projects, Tutorials, and Practical Engineering Solutions

A practical electronics engineering resource focused on tested circuit projects, clear theory
explanations, design calculations and real world troubleshooting support for students, hobbyists,
and professionals.

## Questions Answered with Practical Working Solutions

Backed by more than two decades of hands on circuit design experience, reader questions posted in
the comments are reviewed and answered personally. Wherever necessary, circuit corrections, design
improvements, and verified working solutions are provided to ensure accuracy and reliability.

## How To Use This Website
* Start with the Electronics Tutorials section if you are new to circuit design.
* Explore application based projects to find ready to use circuits.
* Read the comments for practical tips, corrections, and reader discussions.
* Post your questions to get guidance and improvements where needed.

## Learn Electronics Step By Step

### [Electronics Tutorials][10]

Foundational tutorials explaining electronic concepts, calculations, and working principles in a
simple and practical way.

Detailed explanations of semiconductor devices and circuit theory with practical examples and
applications.

### **[Arduino and Microcontrollers][12]**

Arduino programming tutorials and microcontroller based automation projects with complete circuit
details.

### **[IC 555 Timer Circuits][13]**

[555 adjustable duty cycle PWM circuit]

Classic and modern IC 555 timer circuits explained with calculations, diagrams, and application
ideas.

## Power Electronics and Energy Systems

[SG3525 full bridge inverter circuit using P channel mosfets]

Designs that convert DC power into 220V AC with explanations ranging from basic to advanced sine
wave systems.

Controlled battery charging circuits covering lead acid, lithium, and industrial battery systems.

### **[Power Supply Circuits][16]**

[full bridge power supply with calculations]

Fixed and variable voltage power supply projects for workbench testing and embedded applications.

### **[Solar Controllers][17]**

[solar battery charger circuit]

Solar charge controllers and renewable energy projects using PWM, MPPT, and microcontroller
techniques.

## Application Based Electronic Projects

Electronic circuits designed to enhance safety, automation, and efficiency in home electrical
systems.

Control and automation circuits used in industrial machinery and process systems.

Automotive electronic projects for lighting, safety, and performance enhancements.

Speed and torque control circuits for DC and AC motors used in home and industrial applications.

Decorative and functional LED lighting circuits including dimmers, chasers, and drivers.

Wireless and IR remote control circuits for convenient device operation from a distance.

## Specialized and Utility Circuits

### **[Wireless and GSM Projects][24]**

[wireless battery]

Wireless control and GSM based communication projects for monitoring and automation.

### **[Meters and Testers][25]**

Hand-built electronic meters and testers useful for diagnostics and troubleshooting.

### **[Timer and Relay Circuits][26]**

Delay timers and relay switching circuits for automation and protection applications.

A lot of the circuits here slowly get better through questions and discussions in the comments.
Readers point out real world problems, ask for small changes, or request clarifications, and over
time this back and forth helps turn the designs into more reliable and practical working circuits.

explore circuit behavior before building it practically.

fundamental responsibility to protect lives and property. It identifies hazards, evaluates risks,
and creates actionable safety plans. Professional assessments ensure compliance, provide peace of
mind, and may reduce insurance premiums.

(standard for medium-large buildings, offering precise location detection), Wireless (perfect for
heritage buildings requiring minimal disruption), and Twin Wire (cost-effective for small-medium
businesses). The best choice depends on your premises size, layout, and specific requirements.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## Verisure is the global leader by customers served in professionally monitored security services,
## with a market-leading presence across Europe and Latin America

Every day, our dedicated teams use leading technology to protect ~6.3 million families and small
businesses across 18 countries.

With over 35 years of insights, experience, and innovation, Verisure is known for category-creating
marketing, sales excellence, innovative products and services, and customer-centricity.

We provide peace of mind for families and small businesses.

We are the leader in professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America.

We are always innovating and providing the best technology and products to protect our customers.

We are committed to keeping our customers secure.

With our award-winning alarm technology

instant to protect what matters most.

# Advanced Wiring Solutions

## CCTV Systems, Alarm Systems, Surveillance Cameras, and More

### Why Choose Us for Commercial and Home Security?

At Advanced Wiring Solutions we believe the customer and employees our number one priority. This
philosophy flows down to the workforce through conversations between the company’s owners and our
personnel. We believe in providing cost effective solutions for commercial and residential
properties to stay up to date with the latest security features and technology.

We are located in the Frederick, Maryland area and install and service [CCTV systems][26], security
cameras, [security and fire alarm systems][27], [access control systems][28], [home automation
systems][29], voice/data systems, and more throughout the Maryland, Virginia, Washington DC, and PA
regions.

Since 2010, Advanced Wiring Solutions has been a industry leader in commercial and home security
systems. We provide the right solution with professional installation and integration, and our
products are backed by our dependable service and support. We do not believe in any sort of term
based contract. We believe that people can see through the “free” systems that are offered. If you
are unhappy with our service and our promise doesn’t live up to your expectation you are free to
cancel at anytime.

Our goal is to exceed our customer’s expectations by providing exact solutions and listening to our
clients’ needs, while emphasizing a professional, neat appearance.  **We work with our clients to
find solutions to their problems in the most cost-effective manner possible.**

[Learn More About our Security Offerings Today!][30]

### CCTV Systems

**CCTV camera systems can help any business or home to deter theft before it happens,** to catch
someone in the act, or to find out what happened after the fact. Whether you need one camera system
or if you’re looking for large scale multi camera system, or have a existing system that you want to
upgrade with the latest technology we can help make it simple, cost efficient and effective.
[MORE][31]

### Alarm Systems

**Alarm system is a key component in any office, retail, or government space these days.** In order
to keep your business protected. A basic alarm package can provide ample peace of mind to a busy
business owner or manager who knows their business is at risk for break-ins. We offer cost effective
solutions to create the most secure environment possible. Our certified and experienced technicians
will take the time to explain all features. [MORE][32]

### Access Control Systems

**Access Control systems can help to protect your business in many ways.** When used in offices to
protect valuable records, paperwork and inventory, an electric lock and a card reader can be all
that’s needed to provide some peace of mind. Easy to use devices like key fobs, key cards, and most
recently, smart phones can be given privileged user access, timed access, and can even hold contact
information about the tenant or employee to whom it is assigned. [MORE][33]

# Provider][78]

***Delivering industrial-grade intrusion alarm panels, sensors, network alarm systems, and
integrated network alarm monitoring system trusted by security integrators, distributors, and
commercial project contractors worldwide**** — including advanced wireless GSM/4G WiFi alarm systems
ideal for both residential and small-business protection.***

[athenalarm]

Since 2006, Athenalarm has been dedicated to developing professional intrusion alarm systems for
security integrators, distributors, and commercial projects worldwide. We manufacture alarm control
panels, motion detectors, alarm sensors, alarm software, and integrated network alarm monitoring
systems that combine intrusion detection, communication technologies, and centralized management.

Our solutions are designed for banks, schools, factories, warehouses, retail stores, residential
communities, and other security-critical facilities. From standalone alarm installations to
centralized monitoring networks, Athenalarm helps customers build reliable and scalable security
systems tailored to diverse application requirements.

With OEM, ODM, and private-label manufacturing capabilities, supported by continuous innovation and
professional technical support, Athenalarm has become a trusted partner for distributors, system
integrators, and security professionals across global markets. We are committed to delivering
dependable alarm technologies that help create safer and more connected environments.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &
Cybersecurity yang andal.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

contacts with some systems allowing several contacts to be included in a cascade system of phoning.

one on the list is informed, and so forth until verification.

Pros:

Unfortunately we are all vulnerable from being the victims of a crime, however we have created a
[list of things to do to deter unlawful individuals][33].

Have a **visible External Bel**l on your property with 24hr LEDs that can clearly be seen on the
night time warning potential burglars that your alarm is Live! Always set your Alarm when your out
and in bed at night.

**A fully activating Alarm** is very loud, which will make the potential burglar uneasy and
hopefully scare him away!

Have a least **2 Security Lights** on your property, One at the Front and One at the Rear. Lights
are a fantastic deterrent to unlawful individuals as they would prefer to carry out there criminal
activities in the dark!

Have good **quality CCTV System** not only for evidence but to deter unlawful individuals.

**Quality locks** on your Door and Windows is another great way to slow them down or even prevent a
break-in into your property.

**Never leave ladders, gardening equipment** or tools outside your property, e.g. on your driveway
or in your garden! These are perfect items that the burglar will use to help in committing his/her
crime!

**Summary:** Make your property un-attractive to a potential burglar/unlawful individual.. A well
protected property will make this individual think twice about committing a crime on your property.

# Electronic Circuit Projects, Tutorials, and Practical Engineering Solutions

A practical electronics engineering resource focused on tested circuit projects, clear theory
explanations, design calculations and real world troubleshooting support for students, hobbyists,
and professionals.

## Questions Answered with Practical Working Solutions

Backed by more than two decades of hands on circuit design experience, reader questions posted in
the comments are reviewed and answered personally. Wherever necessary, circuit corrections, design
improvements, and verified working solutions are provided to ensure accuracy and reliability.

## How To Use This Website
* Start with the Electronics Tutorials section if you are new to circuit design.
* Explore application based projects to find ready to use circuits.
* Read the comments for practical tips, corrections, and reader discussions.
* Post your questions to get guidance and improvements where needed.

Foundational tutorials explaining electronic concepts, calculations, and working principles in a
simple and practical way.

applications.

Arduino programming tutorials and microcontroller based automation projects with complete circuit
details.

Classic and modern IC 555 timer circuits explained with calculations, diagrams, and application
ideas.

[wireless battery]

time this back and forth helps turn the designs into more reliable and practical working circuits.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

##### How does the process work?

Logic Fire and Security’s protection process consists of four key stages: thorough **Assessment** of
premises by certified experts, custom **Design** of solutions, precise Installation with minimal
disruption, and ongoing **Maintenance** services. This comprehensive approach ensures reliable,
long-term protection for your property.

##### Are you approved contractors?

Yes, Logic Fire and Security are fully certified approved contractors, regularly audited by BAFE,
NSI, NICEIC, and IFEDA. Our BAFE accreditations cover fire alarms, emergency lighting, fire risk
assessment, and extinguishers, with independent audits twice yearly ensuring the highest quality
standards.

##### Why have a fire risk assessment?

A fire risk assessment is both a legal requirement under the Regulatory Reform Order 2005 and a
fundamental responsibility to protect lives and property. It identifies hazards, evaluates risks,
and creates actionable safety plans. Professional assessments ensure compliance, provide peace of
mind, and may reduce insurance premiums.

##### What Type of Fire Alarm System Would Work Well for My Business?

Four main types exist: Conventional (ideal for small premises with simple layouts), Addressable
(standard for medium-large buildings, offering precise location detection), Wireless (perfect for
heritage buildings requiring minimal disruption), and Twin Wire (cost-effective for small-medium
businesses). The best choice depends on your premises size, layout, and specific requirements.

##### What types of intruder alarm systems do you install?

Logic Fire and Security installs advanced commercial intruder alarm systems featuring zone-specific
monitoring, mobile notifications, dual-technology sensors to reduce false alarms, and systems that
comply with the highest industry standards for insurance purposes. All installations are tailored to
specific site requirements following comprehensive assessment.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

marketing, sales excellence, innovative products and services, and customer-centricity.

We are the leader in professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America.

We are always innovating and providing the best technology and products to protect our customers.

We are committed to keeping our customers secure.

framework built for absolute peace of mind.
